purpose: Teach: コマース/押し出し/平米/弐/作製/一任/隔週/通りかかっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、Eコマースの夜明けを見越されたぞ
lines.en: Dad saw the dawn of e-commerce coming, even back when we were starting out.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Warm authority in the voice—one elder speaking of another's foresight. Steady cadence, no rush. Slight lift at the end, as if offering a gift of memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新製品の押し出しを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father always understood how important it was to push new products forward.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment, almost to himself. Respectful, grounded tone. Each phrase deliberate, like he's turning over the memory carefully. No emotion on the surface, but something held underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社の平米数を毎年確認されたぞ
lines.en: Dad checked the square footage of headquarters every single year.
lines.style: Softer now, almost wondering. Like he's noticing the pattern for the first time all over again. Slow, gentle pace. A touch of awe that someone paid such close attention to details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約書に弐の漢数字を使われた
lines.en: Yes. Father always used the formal '2' character in contracts—every one.
lines.style: Nodding inwardly. Voice is quiet, specific. He's seeing the detail—the deliberate choice in that character. Thoughtful pace. Slight pause before the dash, like he's settling into the image.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内紙の作製を社員に任されたぞ
lines.en: Dad trusted the staff to make the company newsletter themselves.
lines.style: Voice carries gentle certainty now. Not wistful but grounded in something observed. Steady, warm tone. The satisfaction of someone who watched trust work in practice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは信頼できる社員に一任された
lines.en: Yes. Even when Father just happened to pass by the floor, he'd stop and speak to people.
lines.style: Voice opens slightly—this one touches him more. Not loud, but warmer. The small, genuine surprise of remembering that kindness in motion. Unhurried, almost tender at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、隔週で経営会議を開かれたぞ
lines.en: Dad held management meetings every other week without fail.
lines.style: Pattern-noting, observant. Voice is steady and clear, like he's recounting something reliable. A touch of quiet pride in the structure, the discipline. Even cadence throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは現場をたまたま通りかかった時も声をかけられた
lines.en: Yes. Father's voice was there—steady, consistent—even in the smallest moments.
lines.style: Closing reflection, voice settling into gratitude. Warm but composed. Each word given its weight. A gentle finality, like the close of a good story. Lingering slightly on the last image.
